| description = Rarely spawns in place of low level monsters in the northeast area.  Multiple spawn points exist. <br><br> '''Spawning Strategy:'''<br>
Kill every fire beetle, skeleton, or brown bear in the valley.  Each mob respawns on a 6:00 timer.  A brown bear that is not a PH spawns at 2550,-1670.  Any other brown bear is on the PH cycle.  This PH brown bear has been sighted spawning at the known listed spawn points for Quid Rilstone.

Alternatively if you have tracking, the PH is the only Brown Bear, Fire Beetle, or Skeleton in the area that can respawn as something other than what it was. You should be able to figure out how to use this to your advantage.
Or: AE every fire beetle, skeleton, and brown bear in the area, wait for respawns, and kill the mob at the top of your tracking window. That's your PH. Wait approx. 8min 30sec and kill the respawn which will appear at the top of your tracking window. Repeat until you get your hood(s). Back to back spawns are possible. This obviously doesn't work well if someone else is in the area killing randomly.

Quid Rilstone and his PHs appear to be on an 8m 30s spawn timer.  The spawn location of the PH appears to rotate.  Unable to verify any specific locs at this time.
